description:
Reid 2095 20" eBike | Electric Cargo Commuter Bike
Combining distinctive moto-inspired styling with practical cargo-carrying features, the Reid 2095 is built for comfortable commuting and everyday adventures.
Inspired by Manly, Sydney's iconic 2095 postcode, the Reid 2095 brings a relaxed coastal influence to urban electric riding. Its distinctive design, integrated bench seat and practical cargo setup make it a versatile choice for daily commutes, shopping trips and journeys around town.
The alloy frame features a convenient step-through design for easier mounting and dismounting, with a frame-mounted battery that keeps the overall look clean and streamlined. An Ananda 250W rear hub motor delivers smooth electric assistance, with 350W peak power and 42Nm of torque to help riders tackle hills and longer journeys. The Ananda display features Bluetooth connectivity and app compatibility, keeping essential ride information close at hand.
The 2095 is available with two battery options to suit different riding requirements. Actual range will vary depending on terrain, rider weight and riding style.
Designed with everyday practicality in mind, the 2095 features an integrated front rack with a maximum load capacity of 15kg, alongside a central-mounted basket for carrying shopping and everyday essentials. The bike has a maximum total payload of 150kg, making it a useful option for riders who need more than a standard commuter eBike.
Wide 20 x 3.0" all-road tyres and double-walled alloy rims provide a stable ride across urban surfaces, while riders can choose between a rigid alloy fork or an optional suspension fork to suit their preferred riding style. A Shimano 7-speed drivetrain offers flexibility across different routes and gradients, while Tektro hydraulic disc brakes with 180mm rotors deliver reliable stopping power.
Combining electric assistance, generous carrying capacity and distinctive café racer-inspired styling, the Reid 2095 offers a practical and characterful alternative to conventional commuter eBikes.
The 2095 eBike is ideal for:

Everyday commuting, with smooth assistance from an Ananda 250W rear hub motor

Carrying shopping and essentials, with an integrated front rack and central-mounted basket

Easy mounting and dismounting, with a convenient step-through alloy frame

Choosing the right range, with two battery options offering up to approximately 60 or 70 miles

Comfort across urban surfaces, with wide 20 x 3.0" tyres and a choice of rigid or suspension fork

Tackling varied routes, with a Shimano 7-speed drivetrain

Confident stopping power, with Tektro hydraulic disc brakes and 180mm rotors

Connected ride information, with a Bluetooth-enabled Ananda display

Carrying heavier loads, with a maximum total payload of 150kg

Battery options:

48V 15Ah (720Wh) – EN50604 certified battery, offering an approximate range of up to 70 miles (112km)

48V 12.75Ah (612Wh) – IEC62133 certified battery, offering an approximate range of up to 60 miles (97km)

Range figures are estimates and will vary depending on terrain, rider weight and riding conditions. Front rack maximum load capacity: 15kg. Total payload capacity: 150kg.

Please make sure to familiarise yourself with eBike information before charging or using your new Reid. You can view and download user manuals and safety instructions here.
